display_name: State Courts Act 1970 (Singapore) -- whole Act, two layers: the law (layer 1) and a seat for a person who starts or defends a civil case in a State Court (layer 2)
maintainer: to be set by the lead who merges this row
seat: A person who wishes to start or defend a civil case in a State Court (a District Court or a Magistrate's Court), asking on facts they can state which court has jurisdiction, within what monetary limit, and what powers the court has.
edition: State Courts Act 1970, 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation (the file's banner reads: version in force from 1/12/2023); source file SCA1970.txt, retrieved 2026-10-01 from https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/SCA1970 (sha256 bb9fa01320f7a370fe8bbc6158a77a2eff632772888911fb61f8c0f6ae617051); a converter's plain-text rendering, not the official text

scope.encoded: The whole Act as printed in the file: ss 1 to 70 and the Schedule, in two layers. Layer 1: ten modules (nouns; Part 1; Part 2; Part 3 with the Schedule; Part 4 in three modules; Part 5; Part 6). Layer 2: the seat, 61 exported questions with @export and @desc, and worked cases.
scope.not_encoded: Inert by reason: the title page, Arrangement of Sections, headings and amendment marks (reason 1, not operative); the Legislative History and Abbreviations, which say they are not part of the Act (reason 1); the short title (s 1), appointments and their staffing (ss 8A(1), 9(1), 10(1), 11(1), 12(1), 14, 18), offices of the State Courts (s 60), the powers to vary the limits by order (ss 30, 52(3)), the direction that Rules of Court regulate appeals (s 47) and the power to make Rules of Court (s 69) (reason 2, machinery). 17 provisions are shown repealed or deleted. Everything the Act sends elsewhere (Rules of Court, orders under ss 30 and 52(3), the Criminal Procedure Code 2010, the Supreme Court of Judicature Act 1969) is an input or NOTHING.
scope.monetary_limits: The Act's own figures: $250,000 (District Court limit) and $60,000 (Magistrate's Court limit), s 2. An order under s 30 or s 52(3) would change every answer that turns on a limit; the layer-1 rules take the order's amount as an input and the seat passes 'no order'.
